ending.1:
One by one, the voices from the bottom fell quiet as their names were called.
Last of all, the bell rang three times, and the lullaby ended.
ending.2:
In your hands, the joined stone slowly stopped beating.
Far above, the grave at the bottom of the spiral quietly closed.
ending.3:
Beneath the lake, Ilda set down the stone at last, and laid her crown upon the floor.
"...Then it is enough."
ending.4:
On the last line of her ledger, Helga wrote her brother's name, the date,
and only: "Seen off."
ending.5:
Riine walks back to the gravekeepers' town with an empty lantern.
Her sleeves no longer need rolling up. They fit.
ending.6:
Adventurers still come to the Last Inn.
The labyrinth eats no one now.
ending.end:
- End of Part 3: The Devouring Labyrinth -
- GRAVEWARD SPIRAL -
